items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta, go-live, notification expansion, affiliate or advertising change, and rights outreach. Conditional only for ordinary reversible growth that adds no new data collection, permissions, credentials, dependencies, or cross-site behavior. Evidence: Woot documentation confirms API access but not redistribution, storage, historical derivatives, public display, alerts, affiliate, or advertising rights; current public terms conflict with the proposed commercial/public data use. Fleet compliance is technical-only: 35 pass, 20 fail, 6 unknown. Security, accuracy, measurement, attribution, privacy, and owner gates remain incomplete. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private, do not send rights outreach, and preserve existing launch and security gates. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, privacy/jurisdiction, affiliate or advertising use, and any regulated or age-sensitive expansion.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active. Progress: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed. Source-rights evidence is documented but proves access only; data-flow and consent evidence are partial; logs, vendor, incident, deletion, correction, access, retention, and notification evidence remain open. No task is closed. Next evidence action: attach one dated read-only bundle containing the repository/config data-flow and retention table, deployed consent and withdrawal capture, GA4 property/data-sharing and retention settings, log-field/access inventory, Cloudflare/vendor terms or DPA status, and incident/data-subject request procedures. Do not change production, enable tracking, send outreach, or mark completion without evidence.

Checklist disposition: ordinary growth work may continue conditionally where existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries are preserved. Do not block ordinary growth solely because telemetry is incomplete. New-site or private/gated-site work requires a concrete preview-only or keep-private decision, documented owner choice, legal/security/measurement gates, and rollback evidence before publication.
